main_text.l: THE
SIMPLE COBLER
OF
AGGAVVAM in AMERICA.
Either I am in an Apoplexie, or that
man is in a Lethargie, who doth
not now sensibly feel God shaking
the Heavens over his head, and
the Earth under his feet: The
Heavens so, as the Sun begins to
turne into darknesse, the Moon in-
to blood, the Starres to fall down
to the ground; So that little Light of Comfort or Counsell
is left to the sonnes of men: The Earth so, as
the foundations are failing, the righteous scarce
know where to finde rest, the Inhabitants stagger
like drunken men: It is in a manner dissolved both in
Religions and Relations: And no marvell; for, they have
defiled it by transgressing the Lawes, changing the
Ordinances, and breaking the Everlasting Cove-
nant. The Truths of God are the Pillars of the world,
whereon States and Churches may stand
quiet if they will; if they will not, He can easily shake
them off into delusions, and distractions e-
nough.
